analyzed_vuln.description: In the 16-bit post-processing path, ff_jpegls_decode_picture casts picture data to uint16_t* and then iterates x from 0 to w=s->width*s->nb_components, but advances rows using linesize/2. If linesize is smaller than w*2 (or otherwise inconsistent), src[x] reads/writes past the row buffer. The crash at line 541 is this out-of-bounds access during left-shift normalization.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: From ff_mjpeg_decode_sos(), malformed JPEG-LS stream parameters (image dimensions/components/bit depth and related header state) are accepted and passed into ff_jpegls_decode_picture(). The PoV drives decoding into the s->bits>8 branch with shift!=0, so the loop at jpeglsdec.c:539-542 executes and uses w-based indexing without validating against linesize-derived row capacity, causing invalid memory access (SEGV).
